text: Harness: reflection stage that writes reflections on parent connections after an idea settles
description: When verify settles an idea (implemented/failed/cancelled), the reflector role gets each parent edge's hypothesis plus the outcome and evidence, and returns one reflection per edge ('held / did not hold / unclear, because...'). Harness writes them via the connection's reflection field. Also: when all children of a parent settle, prompt a reflection one level up. Keeps the experience graph growing as a side effect of normal work.
